description: This file defines internal kernel object structures, functions, and macros for Zephyr OS, including object initialization, dynamic allocation, and internal data representations for kernel objects.

methods.name: k_object_init
methods.description: Initializes a kernel object, making it usable from userspace if it exists.

methods.name: k_object_create_dynamic_aligned
methods.description: Allocates memory and registers it as a kernel object with specified alignment.

methods.name: k_object_create_dynamic
methods.description: Allocates memory and registers it as a kernel object with default alignment.
